description: A screenshot of the "Add Ingestion" user interface, specifically depicting "Step 2: 'Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Raster'" with the "URL Upload" tab selected. The active URL input field displays "https://copernicus-fme.eea.europa.eu/clmsdatadownload/results/18447.zip" with a green checkmark indicating validity. Users are prompted to enter a source URL. Under 'Discrete values' and 'Continuous values' radio buttons, "Continuous values" is selected. Two "Excluded Value" fields show "254" and "255". Below these, there are input fields for "Class Code" (with a hint "Enter a Value which shall be excluded from processing.") and "Layer Name" (with a hint "Enter Layer Name from Dataset which shall be used to generate Input Classes."). At the bottom, a "Drag and Drop" area or an "UPLOAD DOCUMENT/S" button are visible for alternative file submission.
